name: paths
description: Package-owned path resolver for Hasna apps: resolves config/data/state/cache homes honoring HASNA_*_HOME overrides and platform defaults (XDG on Linux, Application Support/Caches/Logs on macOS), with hasna/internal/<app> for internal apps. Ships types and a paths CLI only; no store.

waivedSurfaces.reason: Execution-free path helper; it does not own an HTTP service boundary.
Execution-free path helper; MCP execution belongs to consuming applications.
